name: Wound Dressing
contact_interface: Applied to an open wound, contacting the wound bed and tissue fluid directly
immune_exposure: High — the skin barrier is already broken, so the construct contacts tissue fluid directly

screening.threshold_note: The barrier is breached and the construct contacts tissue fluid directly, so immune exposure is in the same band as injection. The gate is tightened to 0.35 rather than treated as intact skin.

application_techniques: Direct application to the wound bed

name: Mask / Patch
contact_interface: Applied to the face or a local skin area under occlusion
immune_exposure: Moderate — the barrier is intact, but occlusion raises stratum corneum permeability, which lifts both penetration and sensitisation risk

screening.threshold_note: Intact barrier, but occlusion enhances penetration, so immune exposure sits slightly above an unoccluded topical. Standard gate of 0.50.

name: Injectable Filler
contact_interface: Delivered into the dermis or subcutaneous tissue through a needle
immune_exposure: Highest — the barrier is bypassed entirely and the construct enters the tissue; the only one of the five routes that goes into the body

screening.threshold_note: The construct enters the tissue, where the immune system can recognise it directly. Screened against the strictest gate, 0.35.

name: Topical Film
contact_interface: Spread on the skin surface, drying down to or retaining a protein film, with no occlusion
immune_exposure: Low — the barrier is intact and there is no occlusion, so the construct stays largely outside the stratum corneum

screening.threshold_note: Intact barrier with no occlusion, so immune exposure is low. With neither a needle nor occlusion-driven penetration, membrane penetration becomes the main bottleneck. Applied at room temperature, so the thermal stability requirement is the lowest of the five.

name: Hair Care
contact_interface: Coated onto the hair shaft, contacting tissue that is already keratinised and dead
immune_exposure: Lowest — the hair shaft has no blood vessels, lymphatics or immune cells, so the construct never enters the body

screening.threshold_note: The hair shaft is keratinised dead tissue and the construct never reaches the immune system, so the gate is the widest of the five.
extra_gates: No adverse effect on hair feel

emerging_note: The evidence behind this route is still accumulating. On the surface it carries two established companies, but Trautec's E5 evidence comes from its wound-dressing product (Kefuyan, Jiangsu provincial registration no. 20232141168, registered for wound care rather than hair care); hair care appears only as a proposal in the patent. AMSilk's eADF4(C16) reaches only E1, with the dataset stating its evidence is mainly cell-free and ex vivo. No human or regulatory evidence tied to this indication exists.
